notes.title: Improved Steam Deck Integration
notes.notes:
Fix Steamworks SDK so it works on the Steam Deck.
Show onscreen keyboard by pressing A when a text input is focused.

notes.title: Radeon Fix
notes.notes: The game now works correctly on AMD Radeon 6000 and above cards.

notes.title: Add Steam Achievements
notes.notes: Add support for Steam Achievements. The playtest only has a limited test set. There are more in the full game.

notes.title: Add Steamworks SDK Support
notes.notes:
Add Steamworks SDK.
Improve new player experience.

notes.title: Keybind Support Added
notes.notes: This update adds keybinding support and improves the UI colors.

notes.title: Playtest Fixes and Updates
notes.notes:
Add Mountain Lion enemy
Add assets for remaining weapons. Each one is now unique.
Improve help menu to be more readable.

notes.title: Playtest Fixes and Updates
notes.notes:
Add icons for enemy scope and buffs.
Prevent npcs from spawning close to water.
Improve stealing ui.
Additional ui refinements.

notes.title: Playtest Fixes and Updates
notes.notes:
Fix minor UI alignment and display issues.
Base scaling off of window size / 1920 instead of current os scaling values.
Add a flag to zones when they are complete.
Show numbers using spells and items outside of battle.
Allow characters to equip items after trading.

notes.title: Playtest Improvements
notes.notes:
Add lots of sound effects.
Add new spell effects for focus and haste.
Improve rest menu.
Add cost to getting blacksmith / alchemy upgrades.

notes.title: Playtest Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
Improve placement of items in the starting room.
Add feedback when leveling up.
Force zone alignment for mountain zones. Keeps them in the best playable state.
Fix some treasure being assigned to the wrong category.

notes.title: Playtest Update: UI Overhaul
notes.notes: This patch updates the UI to be more readable in more situations.

notes.title: Playtest Alpha 2.1
notes.notes: Constrain players in multiplayer and fix multiplayer active ability triggers.
